description: This file contains build instructions and macros related to building root filesystem images, handling libraries, package management (opkg and apk), and filesystem preparation scripts in a device firmware build environment.

methods.name: mklibs
methods.description: Builds libraries and programs into a staging directory, stripping and copying them to their destination locations.

methods.name: opkg
methods.description: Defines command line options for the opkg package manager.

methods.name: apk
methods.description: Defines command line options for the Alpine apk package manager.

methods.name: clean_ipkg
methods.description: Cleans up opkg package information and removes unnecessary files.

methods.name: prepare_rootfs
methods.description: Prepares the root filesystem directory by copying files, running post-install scripts, and cleaning up version control directories.
